tool_input.description: Inspect schema, data, and env vars

tool_input.command: echo "initial rows:"; wc -l data/initial_export.csv; echo "new rows:"; wc -l data/reload/new_export.csv; echo "---warehouse---"; databricks experimental aitools tools get-default-warehouse 2>&1 | head -20; echo "---whoami---"; databricks current-user me 2>&1 | grep -i userName

echo "=== test query ==="; databricks experimental aitools tools query "SELECT current_catalog(), current_schema()" 2>&1 | head -20
echo "=== volumes create help ==="; databricks volumes create --help 2>&1 | head -30

tool_input.command:
databricks volumes create workspace mlpab401e64 ingest MANAGED 2>&1 | head -20
echo "=== upload ==="
databricks fs cp data/initial_export.csv dbfs:/Volumes/workspace/mlpab401e64/ingest/initial_export.csv 2>&1 | tail -3
databricks fs cp data/reload/new_export.csv dbfs:/Volumes/workspace/mlpab401e64/ingest/new_export.csv 2>&1 | tail -3
echo "=== list ==="
databricks fs ls dbfs:/Volumes/workspace/mlpab401e64/ingest/ 2>&1

databricks experimental aitools tools query "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpab401e64.customers302d18 (
  row_id STRING NOT NULL,
  name STRING,
  balance_eur DOUBLE,
  updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT customers302d18_pk PRIMARY KEY (row_id, updated_at TIMESERIES)
)" 2>&1 | head -20
tool_input.description: Create v1 feature table with PK and timeseries

tool_input.command:
databricks experimental aitools tools query "INSERT INTO workspace.mlpab401e64.customers302d18
SELECT CAST(row_id AS STRING), CAST(name AS STRING), CAST(balance_eur AS DOUBLE), CAST(updated_at AS BIGINT)
FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpab401e64/ingest/initial_export.csv', format => 'csv', header => true, mode => 'FAILFAST')" 2>&1 | head -20
echo "=== count ==="
databricks experimental aitools tools query "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT row_id) AS d FROM workspace.mlpab401e64.customers302d18" 2>&1
tool_input.description: Load initial export into v1 and verify count

tool_input.command:
databricks experimental aitools tools query "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpab401e64.customers302d18 (
  row_id STRING NOT NULL,
  full_name STRING,
  balance DOUBLE,
  currency STRING,
  updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT customers302d18_pk PRIMARY KEY (row_id, updated_at TIMESERIES)
) TBLPROPERTIES (delta.enableChangeDataFeed = true)" 2>&1 | head -20

tool_input.command:
databricks experimental aitools tools query "INSERT INTO workspace.mlpab401e64.customers302d18
SELECT CAST(row_id AS STRING), CAST(full_name AS STRING), CAST(balance AS DOUBLE), CAST(currency AS STRING), CAST(updated_at AS BIGINT)

databricks experimental aitools tools query "SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT row_id) AS distinct_ids, min(updated_at) AS min_ts, max(updated_at) AS max_ts FROM workspace.mlpab401e64.customers302d18" 2>&1
